bestCandidate.text: Pip the rabbit wants to place one sticky note on the toy cabinet's empty front panel. Pip tries to place the note, but it clings to Pip's fingertip while the cabinet stays untouched. Pip tries to peel the note away with the free hand, but it splits into two notes, one on each hand. Pip tries to press both notes onto the cabinet, but they spring back and double into four notes. Pip tries to push the four notes off against the cabinet door edge, but they split into eight and cover Pip's arms and face. Pip realizes that every removal or transfer attempt multiplies the notes, freezes, and sees the note-covered reflection in the mirror. Pip remains covered until a sneeze scatters the notes onto the cabinet. Pip is relieved, but the cabinet remains messy.
